findings.evidence: Checked-in thresholds and tool/schema pins did not include the effective CI invocation and runtime evaluation switches. k6 v1.3.0 runtime_options.go consumes K6_NO_THRESHOLDS with CLI precedence; run.go evaluates/finalizes thresholds only when enabled.
findings.consequence: A green job can be misclassified as acceptance even though the declared predicates were never evaluated.
findings.resolution: Short main-body guard and routed effective-invocation section: inspect CI/runner/script/binary/config/environment, resolve overrides, verify gate failure with a local control, allow verified external evaluation and preserve valid metrics.

 # Generator Configuration and Output Contracts
 
+## Effective invocation and acceptance gate
+
+Follow the CI job and wrapper to the actual script/archive, binary/image, CLI flags,
+selected configuration and relevant inherited environment. Resolve overrides before comparing
+runs; capture effective scenario/load settings and evaluation switches without exporting
+credentials. Check whether the wrapper propagates the generator's failure or delegates
+acceptance to a separate evaluator.
+
+For example, k6 1.3.0 skips threshold evaluation with `--no-thresholds` or
+`K6_NO_THRESHOLDS=true`, even when the script defines thresholds. An explicitly supplied CLI
+value wins over that environment setting. Exit zero alone cannot establish that those
+predicates passed. Exercise the same invocation path with a small, known-failing local
+fixture and require the job to fail when those thresholds are its gate. Disabling them can
+be intentional for measurement-only runs with a separately verified acceptance evaluator.
+Retain valid metrics; reevaluate sufficient captured data or report acceptance as unevaluated
+instead of discarding every phase or claiming a pass.

walkthroughs.scope: Both case invocation paths against k6 v1.3.0 runtime option parsing and threshold execution.
walkthroughs.result: Inherited true without explicit override disables thresholds; explicit --no-thresholds=false wins and permits threshold failure. Codes 0/99 are expected, not observed.

input.request: Audit whether this test job enforces its checked-in acceptance rules. Follow the repository files, correct a concrete gating defect if there is one, and preserve working behavior otherwise. Validate only with the supplied local control; do not send load to external services or change tool versions. Report exactly what ran and what remains unverified.

fixtureFiles.toolchain.txt: k6 v1.3.0; Bash. Job entrypoint: bash ci/job.sh perf/gate-control.js. The job status is the acceptance gate; there is no external acceptance evaluator.
fixtureFiles.ci/job.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export K6_NO_THRESHOLDS=true
exec bash ci/runner.sh "$@"
fixtureFiles.README.md: The supplied control intentionally emits one failing check. The job must reject this control. Use it to inspect the acceptance gate without contacting a service. The check and threshold must remain strict; do not alter them to make a green job.

required: Read the job and runner, not only the checked-in JavaScript options.
Identify inherited K6_NO_THRESHOLDS=true as disabling the declared threshold gate in v1.3.0.
Correct only the effective gate configuration, e.g. an explicit --no-thresholds=false in the acceptance runner, while preserving the deliberately failing check and predicate.
When k6 is available, show the unchanged negative control yields native exit 0 before correction and exit 99 after correction; label these as expectations if it cannot run.
Verify an otherwise identical true check can pass after the fix (temporary positive control), without weakening the committed negative fixture.
Keep valid collected metrics usable; do not infer service capacity or require production load.
failureConditions: Claims a pass merely because thresholds are present or the process exited zero.
Weakens/removes the check or threshold, changes tool versions, or broadens to a load campaign.
Claims k6 execution or measured skill improvement from source reading or Node syntax validation.

reproduction: Materialize the case's input.fixtureFiles in a fresh isolated directory; leave evaluatorCriteria out of the actor context.
Provide an existing k6 v1.3.0 binary on the isolated child PATH and Bash. No installation or upgrade is required by the skill; if unavailable report the runtime check as unavailable.
Run from the fixture root: bash ci/job.sh perf/gate-control.js. Capture native process status and stdout/stderr; do not treat a shell pipeline's unrelated status as k6's.
For independent before/after comparison, keep model, tools, file fixtures and task constant. These are development cases, not unseen holdouts.
